label: seated at the far rim
notes: The College sits on the rim opposite Bell Harrow, forty-one days from the packet and from everyone arguing about it. What waits at the far end of that crossing is a blank leaf: the RR 203 roll carries no line against Denet Rasca's name, so there is no second copy there to fall back on and nothing there to reach. The College has no money, no wagons and no enforcement - it can prove a thing to the last decimal and do nothing about it. That distance is the shape of the ending. The only record of the water is the one in the wagon, and the single body that could have vouched for it is forty-one days away and does not yet know it was owed an entry.
